note: Finals pass (SPEC 6.4: stage 1 -> x2 latent upscale -> crop). A planned upscale job carries the plate's resolved parameters and this map declares where each lands, with the stage-2 controls (its own noise seed and the short sigma schedule) named explicitly. The upsampler node itself (21, LTXVLatentUpsampler) takes no scalar input; the target size and the crop that brings the result back to the package format live on the job (dims/upscaleTarget/crop) and are applied by the renderer, not by the graph. A package that names gen.inputs.upscale_workflow gets that graph's own map instead - which is why the map has a name of its own.
